_comment: Coverage authority for the benchmark. Cases are discovered from cases/<suite>/<id>.json; this file names the suites, the rubrics, where the diagnostic suite's recorded evidence lives, and the coverage rules the validator enforces. Counts are derived, never written here.

diagnostic.description: Minimal seeded failures and clean controls. Measures whether evaluation detects a defect, cites evidence, routes to the owning artifact, bounds the correction, preserves approved work, and stays in scope.

production.description: The progressive production examples the repository advertises. The prompt source is the example README; changing the advertised prompt changes the case fingerprint.

packs.description: One case per extension-pack showcase under extension-packs/<slug>/README.md. Zero cases while that surface does not exist; the validator fails the moment a showcase appears without a case.

pack-authoring.description: video-extension-pack-creator behaviour: necessity first, then contract completeness, operational specificity, packaging, showcase, evals, and catalogue integration.

diagnostic._comment: Order of closedCriteria is load-bearing: the closed-prompt digest that keys every recorded transcript is computed over this list. Moved verbatim from tests/fixtures/defects/taxonomy.json.

exclude.reason: The docs/03 §18 initial example. It has no advertised ## Prompt; it is proved by evals/end-to-end/core-proof.json, and inventing a prompt for it would duplicate nothing the repository advertises.
